author: goblirsc
body:
#### PR description:

Update the reference alignment result in the Millepede alignment CI test.

A bug was recently fixed in Millepede-II that led to inconsistent weights being used when outlier reweighting was enabled.
This was deployed starting with version 05-01-07. 
[cmsdist 11004](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmsdist/pull/11004 ) deploys the updated Millepede version. 

As the bugfix affects the alignment results, the `Alignment/MillePedeAlignmentAlgorithm/test_PayloadSanity`  and `Alignment/MillePedeAlignmentAlgorithm/test_PedeConversion` will flag an inconsistency with the reference result (made with the bug) and report a failure.

This PR updates the reference alignment tag for these tests to the result with the bugfix. It should be merged when deploying the externals update from [cmsdist 11004](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmsdist/pull/11004 ). 

#### PR validation:
`scram b runtests` succeeds with the updates, fails without (when running with the updated externals) 

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

No backport intended.
title: update reference file for alignment CI test
